title: Research: rank-16 delivery survives every legal rank-1 surcharge
body:
## Result

Negative screen, no new kappa. Delivering the selected local mass as rank-16 children and spending all 1646 idle-mass units on extra rank-1 children still clears the five-percent ceiling gate.

At grid `1e-15` the selected ceiling is `1690054109089/1000000000000000` and the surcharged ceiling is `285077936577/125000000000000`. Their ratio is `2280623492616/1690054109089`, about 1.349, against the gate `21/20`. One further rank-1 child is rejected by the coverage law. `ceiling.py` is not edited.

This is not the ideal rank-16 row in `levers.py`, which leaves idle at rank 51. It is also not the high-rank idle packings in #3811 and #3874. Claim: [#4065](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4065). The same chooser's helper 600/601 sign test is [#4061](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4061).

## Scope

Chooser seed `fb1b693e95073cda2220efd59e654728`, card `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 6, base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. The drawn `p104-side-correction` flag scan was not repeated. Package: `research/rank16-rank1-surcharge-screen`. Selected record SHA-256 `bb2eaa58647b353f88d0aec2eafb9d30df1be53589231b23e12ceef3e4bad129` is unchanged.

## Evidence

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank16-rank1-surcharge-screen
```

Expected marker: `PASS_RANK16_RANK1_SURCHARGE`. Local Python 3.12 replay passed. The selected baseline was not run: this partial checkout cannot import the frontier1094 assembly roots.

## Limits

No decoder, frame, restoration, or hosting price. A charge this coverage law cannot express as rank-1 children remains open. Substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed. Apache-2.0.

## Open next question

Which sourced copy, frame or restoration histogram, outside extra rank-1 children, pushes rank-16 delivery under the five-percent gate? The first step is to pin one such histogram and screen that exact profile.
